🚆 One day of trains in Italy — Thursday 8 October 2026.

9,461 scheduled trains across 2,186 stations. Frecciarossa and Italo trace the high-speed spine Turin–Milan–Bologna–Florence–Rome–Naples, while Lombardy's regional web lights up around Milan. Two rush hours: 1,084 trains on the move at 07:18, 1,080 at 18:43. Each ring is a train calling at a station.

📊 Data: Trenitalia & Italo GTFS (Italian National Access Point, converted by deryclem) and Trenord GTFS (Regione Lombardia), CC BY 4.0. Positions interpolated between stops; stations joined in straight lines.
🌍 Relief: AWS Terrain Tiles · Natural Earth.
